digest.component_or_area: capabilities registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate that each of 14 immutable capability records references exactly one declared packaging extra and one typed missing posture (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without importing its probe module.
Stable commands and top-level help must remain functional in a no-extras wheel; only the selected execution boundary must emit an actionable error for error-posture capabilities.
Lean diagnostic, read, and dry-run modes must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities (e.g., audit show without audit_ui, review workflows without agent_runtime).

Domain components must retain full control over result payloads, exceptions, logging, and exit codes for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures; the registry provides metadata only and never manufactures domain results.
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot must consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry.
Existing _optional.require_extra and guard_import surfaces must remain compatible, delegating to the new semantic registry where applicable.
